question: How do I check what capabilities a model has using the API?
ground_truth: Call the GET /v1/models endpoint to retrieve model information. Each model includes capability boolean flags: can_do_text_to_speech (supports TTS), can_do_voice_conversion (supports speech-to-speech), can_be_finetuned (supports fine-tuning), can_use_style (supports style parameter), can_use_speaker_boost (supports speaker boost), serves_pro_voices (serves professional voices), and requires_alpha_access (requires alpha access). Character limits are also provided: max_characters_request_free_user, max_characters_request_subscribed_user, and maximum_text_length_per_request.
